types.AbstractCapabilityInclude: Inclusion of a Capability in another one (reference via 'included').
types.AbstractCapabilityRealization: Traceability link between a Capability and the upper-layer Capability/OperationalCapability it realizes.
types.AbstractFunctionAbstractCapabilityInvolv: Involvement of a Function in a Capability (reference via 'involved').
types.AbstractStateRealization: Traceability link between a State/Mode and the upper-layer State/Mode it realizes.
types.ActivityAllocation: Allocation of an OperationalActivity to a Role performing it. Related to the Role concept, excluded from the Python4Capella API.
types.BooleanPropertyValue: Boolean-typed variant of PropertyValue. CONFIRMS limitation PV-001: the actual technical metamodel uses distinct types per value kind (BooleanPropertyValue, and probably StringPropertyValue/IntegerPropertyValue/FloatPropertyValue/EnumerationPropertyValue not observed in the samples), whereas Python4Capella unifies them under a single PropertyValue type.
types.CapabilityExploitation: Link between a Capability and another Capability it exploits (reference via the 'capability' attribute).
types.CapabilityInvolvement: Involvement of an Actor/Component in a Capability exploiting it (reference via 'involved').
types.CapabilityRealizationInvolvement: Involvement of a Component in a CapabilityRealization (contributing to realizing the capability).
types.CatalogElement: Generic REC/RPL catalog element (Requirement/RE add-on). See REC and RPL in the Python4Capella document for the equivalent business semantics.
types.CatalogElementLink: Link between a REC (origin) and its RPLs (replicas), expressing the replication relationship.
types.ChoicePseudoState: Choice pseudo-state (conditional branch) in a StateMachine/Region.
types.Collection: Data type representing a collection (list/set) of elements of a given type. Python4Capella equivalent: Collection (DataType subtype).
types.ComponentExchangeAllocation: Allocation of a ComponentExchange to an element of a different layer.
types.ComponentPortAllocation: Allocation of a ComponentPort to an element of a different layer.
types.ComponentRealization: Traceability link (sourceElement/targetElement) between a Component and the upper-layer Component it realizes (e.g. PhysicalComponent realizes LogicalComponent).
types.ConceptPkg: Package containing Concepts (Operational Analysis), a notion not documented in the Python4Capella Simplified Metamodel (absent from the source document).
types.ControlNode: Control node in a FunctionalChain (AND/OR/ITERATE), driving the chain flow. Excluded from the Python4Capella API (explicitly listed as an exclusion in the Foreword of the Python4Capella document).
types.DeepHistoryPseudoState: Deep history pseudo-state in a StateMachine/Region.
types.Entity: Entity at Operational Analysis level. If actor='true', represents an OperationalActor.
types.EntityOperationalCapabilityInvolvement: Involvement of an Entity in an OperationalCapability.
types.EventReceiptOperation: Event receipt operation in a Scenario.
types.EventSentOperation: Event sending operation in a Scenario (linked to a SequenceMessage).
types.Execution: Execution period of an InstanceRole in a Scenario (vertical bar of the sequence diagram).
types.ExecutionEnd: Fragment marking the end of an Execution in a Scenario.
types.ExecutionEvent: Event triggering an Execution in a Scenario.
types.FragmentEnd: End of a combined fragment (CombinedFragment) in a Scenario.
types.FunctionRealization: Traceability link between a Function and the upper-layer Function it realizes.
types.FunctionalChainAbstractCapabilityInvolve: Involvement of a FunctionalChain in a Capability.
types.FunctionalChainInvolvementFunction: Involvement of a Function in a FunctionalChain (chain step). References the Function via the 'involved' attribute.
types.FunctionalChainInvolvementLink: Involvement of a FunctionalExchange in a FunctionalChain, with source/target giving the topological traversal order in the chain.
types.FunctionalChainRealization: Traceability link between a FunctionalChain and the upper-layer FunctionalChain/OperationalProcess it realizes.
types.FunctionalChainReference: Reference to a FunctionalChain from inside another FunctionalChain (nested chains).
types.FunctionalExchangeRealization: Traceability link between a FunctionalExchange and the upper-layer one it realizes.
types.GenericTrace: Generic traceability link between any two elements, without cross-layer realization semantics (unlike TransfoLink, which is rather used for transformation traces). Excluded from the Python4Capella API ('Generic Traces' explicitly listed as an exclusion in the Foreword).
types.InformationRealization: Traceability link between a Class/ExchangeItem and the upper-layer one it realizes.
types.InitialPseudoState: Initial pseudo-state (entry point) of a Region.
types.InteractionOperand: Operand of a CombinedFragment (e.g. branch of an ALT) in a Scenario.
types.InteractionState: State/activity shown in a Scenario, linked to a Function or a State (relatedAbstractFunction/relatedAbstractState).
types.InteractionUse: Reference to another Scenario included in the current Scenario.
types.KeyValue: Key-value pair used for metadata/extensions (e.g. storing PVMT parameters or other add-ons).
types.LiteralBooleanValue: Boolean literal value (true/false) used as an Enumeration literal or a Property default value.
types.LogicalArchitectureRealization: Traceability link between the PhysicalArchitecture and the LogicalArchitecture it realizes.
types.MessageEnd: End (start or finish) of a SequenceMessage in a Scenario.
types.MissionInvolvement: Involvement of a Capability in a Mission (reference via 'involved').
types.ModelInformation: Technical metadata of the model (version and origin information).
types.OpaqueExpression: Free (text) expression used as a computed value, typically to express a non-literal min/max bound or a condition.
types.OperationalAnalysisRealization: Traceability link between the SystemAnalysis and the OperationalAnalysis it realizes.
types.Part: Instance/role of a Component in the context of its parent component. References the actual definition via the abstractType='#<id>' attribute. This is the central hierarchical containment mechanism visible in the Capella Project Explorer (see instantiation_pattern section).
types.PartDeploymentLink: Deployment link: a Part (deployedElement) is deployed on another Part (location). Used for software/hardware deployment in Physical Architecture.
types.PhysicalArchitectureRealization: Traceability link between the EPBSArchitecture and the PhysicalArchitecture it realizes.
types.PhysicalArtifactRealization: Traceability link between a ConfigurationItem (EPBS) and the PhysicalComponent (PA) it realizes.
types.PhysicalPathInvolvement: Involvement of a PhysicalLink in a PhysicalPath, chained through nextInvolvements to express the topological order of the physical path.
types.PortRealization: Traceability link between a port (Function/Component) and the upper-layer one it realizes.
types.PropertyValueGroup: Grouping of several PropertyValues under the same named group (e.g. grouping by theme/add-on). Documented in the Word doc under PropertyValueGroup.
types.PropertyValuePkg: Container package for PropertyValue/PropertyValueGroup/EnumerationPropertyType, attached to a PropertyValuePkgContainer (e.g. SystemEngineering, or any CapellaElement supporting extensions).
types.Role: Operational role (e.g. 'Common Role: Non functional constraints engineering'), assignable to Entity/OperationalActivity. Excluded from the Python4Capella API ('Roles in the Operational Analysis' explicitly listed as an exclusion in the Foreword).
types.RoleAllocation: Allocation of a Role to the Entity assuming it (probably sourceElement=Entity, targetElement=Role). Excluded from the Python4Capella API.
types.RolePkg: Package containing the Roles of the Operational Analysis. Excluded from the Python4Capella API (explicitly mentioned: 'Roles in the Operational Analysis' are excluded).
types.ScenarioRealization: Traceability link between a Scenario and the upper-layer one it realizes.
types.SequenceLink: Conditional link between two ControlNodes in a FunctionalChain. Excluded from the Python4Capella API.
types.StateTransitionRealization: Traceability link between a StateTransition and the upper-layer one it realizes.
types.SystemAnalysisRealization: Traceability link between the LogicalArchitecture and the SystemAnalysis it realizes.
types.SystemComponent: Component at System Analysis level. If the actor='true' attribute is set, represents a system Actor (Python4Capella equivalent: SystemActor). Without this attribute on the package root element, represents the System itself (Python4Capella equivalent: System).
